method: Whole cfg.c/h read with Git blob verification.
findings: Default initialization zeroes all settings, so xattr read/write and optional name/path matching filters are disabled before argument parsing. Prior cache-admission findings therefore concern explicitly enabled paths, not default xattr use.

Defaults: BLAKE2B digest, hidden files ignored, minsize1, empty-file lint enabled, hardlinked duplicates enabled, see_symlinks true and follow_symlinks false. Traversal interpretation of these options remains to inspect.

Default full-file range starts0 ends1.0 factor with clamping disabled. Buffer16KiB,16 hash threads,2 threads per disk,1GiB target memory. Header explicitly calls memory target-only, confirming it is not hard cap.

Input root admission uses access then readlink fallback, realpath or lexical canonicalization. Thus ordinary root inputs are made absolute before trie insertion; descendant and replay paths still need inspection.
Root provenance lookup walks ancestors and configured path list, with preferred-path list ordering as explicit precondition. Hidden components may stop traversal; TODO partial-hidden remains.
JSON replay roots return before path_count increment in this function although header describes common index accounting; caller behavior needed before claiming duplicated replay indexes.
limits: Defaults may be changed by command-line parser; no command execution or runtime conformance verified.
No rrrah edits or fresh tests; native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
